name: @p01/circuits
description: Zero-knowledge circuits for Protocol 01 — shielded pool + zkSPL confidential balances

scripts.setup: snarkjs groth16 setup build/transfer.r1cs keys/pot20_final.ptau build/transfer_0000.zkey
scripts.contribute: snarkjs zkey contribute build/transfer_0000.zkey build/transfer_0001.zkey --name="First contribution" -v
scripts.finalize: snarkjs zkey beacon build/transfer_0001.zkey build/transfer_final.zkey 0102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f 10 -n="Final Beacon phase2"
scripts.export-vk: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/transfer_final.zkey build/verification_key.json
scripts.export-solidity: snarkjs zkey export solidityverifier build/transfer_final.zkey build/verifier.sol
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run setup && npm run contribute && npm run finalize && npm run export-vk
scripts.setup:zkspl: snarkjs groth16 setup build/confidential_balance.r1cs keys/pot20_final.ptau build/confidential_balance_0000.zkey
scripts.contribute:zkspl: snarkjs zkey contribute build/confidential_balance_0000.zkey build/confidential_balance_0001.zkey --name="First contribution" -v
scripts.finalize:zkspl: snarkjs zkey beacon build/confidential_balance_0001.zkey build/confidential_balance_final.zkey 0102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f 10 -n="Final Beacon phase2"
scripts.export-vk:zkspl: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/confidential_balance_final.zkey build/confidential_balance_vk.json
scripts.build:zkspl: npm run compile:zkspl && npm run setup:zkspl && npm run contribute:zkspl && npm run finalize:zkspl && npm run export-vk:zkspl
scripts.setup:bproof: snarkjs groth16 setup build/balance_proof.r1cs keys/pot20_final.ptau build/balance_proof_0000.zkey
scripts.contribute:bproof: snarkjs zkey contribute build/balance_proof_0000.zkey build/balance_proof_0001.zkey --name="First contribution" -v
scripts.finalize:bproof: snarkjs zkey beacon build/balance_proof_0001.zkey build/balance_proof_final.zkey 0102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f 10 -n="Final Beacon phase2"
scripts.export-vk:bproof: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/balance_proof_final.zkey build/balance_proof_vk.json
scripts.build:bproof: npm run compile:bproof && npm run setup:bproof && npm run contribute:bproof && npm run finalize:bproof && npm run export-vk:bproof
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:zkspl && npm run build:bproof
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:zkspl && npm run test:bproof

author: Protocol 01 Team
